isMainAdIds.description: If true, loads primary MainAdIds first.

isSubAdIds.description: If true, loads secondary SubAdIds as fallback when Main fails.

isShowAdsURL.description: Master switch for custom web fallback ads. If false, web promotional banners are disabled.

MainAdIds.description: JSON bundle of production primary AdMob / Ad Manager Unit IDs.

SubAdIds.description: JSON bundle of secondary fallback AdMob / Ad Manager Unit IDs.

clickCount.description: Click threshold for Interstitial Ads inside the Downloader app (shows ad every N clicks).

app_open_click_count.description: Threshold for App Open Ad on cold launch.

app_open_resume_count.description: Threshold for App Open Ad on resume from background.

is_app_open_on_resume.description: Enable or disable App Open Ad when returning to the app from background.

isLauncherAdsShow.description: Global master switch for Launcher Ads. If true, launcher ads are active. If false, launcher is completely ad-free.

launcherClickCount.description: Number of app launches/clicks in the Launcher before triggering an ad.

isLauncherWebAdShow.description: If true, launcher alternates between Interstitial Ad and Web Ad URL redirection on reaching launcherClickCount. If false, always shows Interstitial Ad.

AdsURL.description: Target landing URLs for web promotional ads. Can be a single URL string or a JSON array of URLs (e.g. ["https://link1.com", "https://link2.com"]). If multiple links are provided, pressing Back in Custom Tab sequentially opens the next link in the array until all links are visited.

AdsImgClickURl.description: Target click URL for promotional image/card redirection.

web_native_ads.description: JSON array of remote web native ad image URLs for fallback promotion.
